title: Event-window reaction study for calendar classes with no consensus (fed_speak, treasury_auction): build the harness, pre-register, run
note: Child of CALENDAR-EVENT-TYPES (roadmap M28). fed_speak and treasury_auction are emitted at weight 0 but have no consensus column, so scripts/research/macro_event_study_run.py (surprise vs forward return) cannot grade them. BUILD: an event-window reaction harness: abs forward return / range over [t0, t0+h] for event windows vs matched non-event windows (same weekday and hour), SPY and BTC/ETH, net of the full cost stack if a trade rule is proposed; pre-register the rule and n BEFORE the run (distinct events, not rows). DONE WHEN: a queue unit per class exists with a graded result. Weight stays 0 until a Tier-3 proposal cites the verdict. Check scripts/research/ (RESEARCH-CAPABILITY-INDEX.md) for an existing reaction harness before building.
